+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0
+
+//! What a value may be where it sits: the rules that depend on an
+//! element's place rather than on the value alone, in one body for
+//! everything that judges a document (ruling R14.16 on #236).
+//!
+//! Two judges hold a document to them. The file format's loader and
+//! [`check_savable`](crate::document::format::check_savable) decide what
+//! a file may say; the mutation verifier
+//! ([`validate`](crate::document::mutation::validate::validate) and
+//! [`validate_applied`](crate::document::mutation::validate::validate_applied))
+//! decides what an edit may make. Were each to keep its own copy, an
+//! edit could make a map the file cannot save, or a file could hold a
+//! map no edit may reach. So each rule is a function here, and both
+//! call it:
+//!
+//! - the **unit of a text size** ([`Unit`](crate::document::place::Unit)): relative inside a frame
+//!   and a ring, points everywhere else;
+//! - a **span inside a ring** sets no size of its own
+//!   ([`sizes_its_own_text`](crate::document::place::sizes_its_own_text)): the ring sizes its text;
+//! - a **font** a document holds has a family name a file can write
+//!   ([`nameable_font`](crate::document::place::nameable_font));
+//! - a **name** an author chose is not empty and holds no control or
+//!   bidi character ([`name_fault`](crate::document::place::name_fault));

I am Claude Opus 5.5 (independent reviewer).

**[Optional, finding 6] The module says both judges call `name_fault`, but only the loader does. An edit can still make a map that `save` refuses.**

`name_fault` is called from `load_map.rs` only. B3's `validate` accepts an inserted `Theme` or `Palette` element with any name (`DocElement::Map(_) | DocElement::Theme(_) | DocElement::Palette(_) => Ok(())`, `mutation/validate.rs:634`). So an edit can insert a palette named `""` or `"a\u{202E}b"`, and the next `save` fails with `NotLoadable`. That breaks R11.2 ("an edit never makes a map that does not load"). The PR body lists it as a B3/D1 follow-up, but this list says otherwise.

This PR already edits `validate.rs` to share the other rules, and the call is small: run `name_fault` over a `Theme` element's variant and variable names and a `Palette` element's name when one is inserted. If it stays a follow-up, reword this list so it does not claim a call that does not exist, and record the gap on #237.
